A) 30 coins
B) 50 coins (my pick)
C) 80 coins
Why: Game rules want it well under one job day (about 290).
A new player starts with 120 coins. 50 leaves room for food.
After the cure the mood is only normal (your pick B), so the vet is no shortcut to happiness.
Pay per pet treated (one visit treats every sick pet with you). Late = book again, no coins lost (How a vet visit works).
Compare: new pet 200, pet bed 80, bus ride 20.
Too few coins: the vet is free (you decided 31 Oct).
Stage pfu-2 (Plan's later row; an earlier row said pfu-4).
